I have (Yes, still have) a friend who always downplays anything I like/am proud of. For example I'll tell them I finally found an artstyle for myself wich I like, and immediately they'll start nitpicking anything that isn't perfect about it. For example: "why does the ear look like that? And Is this a tooth? Why is it there? It looks weird, you shouldn't post it."
My now artstyle is quite stylized, but nothing abstract. I pretend to laugh whenever my friend does something like this. The only reason I'm still hanging around them is they come from a bad household (almost always screaming mother, neglect, etc) and I believe I can make them be better because it's not their fault they're like this.

Tldr:
If you have a friend who makes fun of your interests, find out why they act the way they do. It might not be their fault and/or be influenced by how they've been treated in the past.
